title.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

description.zh:
1931 年九一八事变至 1945 年日本签署投降书，中国人民进行了长达十四年的抗日战争。本专题以日军进攻、中国各抗日部队与盟军为主线，分设国民党军正面战场、集团军、八路军、新四军、华南游击队、中国政府、中国民众、国际组织与多边会议等实体，分别呈现正面战场部队序列、华北华中敌后根据地与政治外交事件，呈现从东北沦陷、全面抗战爆发、战略相持到最终胜利的时空脉络。

> 部分战役路线（淞沪、平型关、忻口、台儿庄、兰封、随枣、昆仑关、南京、武汉、长沙（第一、二、三次会战）、枣宜、上高、中条山、鄂西、常德、衡阳、湘西、滇西、百团、远征军/缅北、豫湘桂）据常见战史地图整理；其余路线为示意简化。2026-11-16 起按 C5—C7 端点核查计划分批核对线头线尾：日军进攻线 21 处已补灵丘、大同、青岛、菏泽、开封、商城、芜湖、归绥、舞阳、当阳、郑州、深圳、曼德勒、杭州、安阳、荆州、公安、邵阳等出兵或占领节点，一·二八段改为虹口—闸北，兰封段改为菏泽—兰封—开封，六安段改为六安—商城；中国军队的忻口、平型关、昆仑关、百团大战、上高、中条山、鄂西、滇西等 12 处与盟军/华南 6 处也已核对：忻口段改为南怀化—大白水战场线，百团大战西端校正至榆次并补正太路破袭事件，昆仑关段补第 5 军自柳州反攻，滇西反攻补保山强渡怒江与攻克畹町两端；华南游击队三条活动区尾端按示意线登记。2026-11-19 补录 1932—1936 年事件 26 条（锦州沦陷、榆关抗战、热河作战、长城抗战、察哈尔民众抗日同盟军、塘沽协定、何梅协定、秦土协定、绥远抗战等）与 12 段路线，填上伪满洲国成立至一二·九运动之间的空档。2026-11-19 起把「中国抗战力量」叙事链按参战部队拆分，并把原混合层进一步拆为「中国政府」与「中国民众」：删除阳泉—昆明等 10 段跨战区转场线，军事路线改挂国民党军正面战场、集团军、八路军与盟军，并补第74军、第5军、第10军、第33集团军、第18军等部队战史线。2026-11-19 另设「国际组织与多边会议」，把李顿调查团、国联大会通过报告书与九国公约会议从中国政府层移出，并补 1931 年中国向国联申诉事件。2026-11-20 梳理八路军层：事件由 11 条增至 29 条，补雁门关、阳明堡、七亘村、神头岭、响堂铺、长乐村、齐会、黄土岭、关家垴、狼牙山、韩略村、南下支队与 1945 年大反攻，路线由 9 段增至 24 段。2026-11-20 另补八路军战略转变三个节点：洛川会议确定「独立自主的山地游击战」，太原失守后的石拐会议部署三师分兵，1938 年 4 月《关于平原游击战的指示》后第129师挺进冀南。事件 366 → 370，路线 238 → 241。2026-11-20 补第115师主力入鲁（1939-03）与山东纵队由本地起义武装编成的说明，并补第129师挺进冀南后的平原展开；专题事件 370 → 371，路线 241 → 242。2026-11-20 起按「行为主体」全面补录日军战线：东北补长春、吉林、齐齐哈尔与《日满议定书》；华北补北平、天津、张家口、保定、石家庄、娘子关、归绥、包头、济南、杭州、金山卫登陆、伪临时/维新政府、兴亚院、广田三原则、两次近卫声明、华北/华中开发会社、陶德曼调停；华南补厦门、汕头、潮州、宝安、南宁、香港、上海租界，以及雷州半岛与广州湾；华中补南昌、安庆、九江、徐州、宜昌、宁绍、温州三次沦陷、福州两次沦陷；战略层补海岸封锁、成都大轰炸、宁波/常德/浙赣细菌战、平顶山/潘家峪/北疃/厂窖惨案；1942—1945 补滇西入侵、衢州/上饶、温州第二/第三次沦陷、豫湘桂各城陷落、独山、湘粤赣边区韶关/南雄/大余/赣州/遂川机场、老河口、台湾光复。日军 128 → 281 事件、64 → 124 段路线；专题 377 → 529 事件、243 → 303 段。2026-11-20 另按 M204 补海南日军行动：田独铁矿、石八铁路、榆林—北黎铁路、田独万人坑、首轮占领、1942 年“扫荡”、1945 年受降；补田独—榆林、榆林—北黎两段供应线，专题 461 → 468 事件、268 → 270 段。2026-11-20 再按 M205 补海南占领范围：崖县、定安、文昌、澄迈、嘉积、临高、儋县、陵水、屯昌、感恩、昌江、万宁、保亭、乐东等县城沦陷，以及 1940-03「日军占领海南环岛县城与据点」总览；日军占领 14 县县城和大部分市镇，设 360 多个据点、195 个维持会，白沙县城和五指山周围山区未被长期占领。日军 220 → 235 事件，专题 468 → 483 事件，路线不变。2026-11-20 再按 M206 补海南登陆点与出发地：澄迈湾/老城、崖州湾头灶港/大旦港/马岭、白马井、清澜港、八所/北黎五个登陆点，以及老城—金江、白马井—新英—新州、头灶港—崖城、海口—定安、海口—文昌—清澜、三亚—藤桥—陵水、文昌—嘉积、金江—临高、嘉积—万宁、陵水—保亭、崖城—乐东、八所—石碌、八所—墩头—新街十三段进攻路线；日军 235 → 240 事件、91 → 104 段路线，专题 483 → 488 事件、270 → 283 段。屯昌、感恩、嘉积具体出发地待考，未硬连线。2026-11-20 再按 M207 细化广东日军战线：三灶岛首次占领/莲塘湾登陆/大屠杀，大亚湾平海/稔山、盐灶背、澳头/霞涌三路登陆，淡水、惠州、博罗、增城、从化、虎门，三水、佛山、顺德、番禺、江门、新会、中山、唐家/香洲登陆，宝安第一/第三次沦陷，南澳、澄海，以及广州、汕头受降；补平海—稔山—惠州等十五段路线。日军 240 → 267 事件、104 → 119 段路线；专题 488 → 515 事件、283 → 298 段。2026-11-20 再按 M208 补粤北会战节点：第一次补小楼/正果、永汉、从化、良口、梅坑/吕田、新丰、翁源、英德、新江；第二次补花县、街口、鸡笼冈、良口、石榴花顶；补广州—花县—银盏坳—源潭—英德等五段路线，并补 1940-01 与 1940-06 五段 retreat 撤退线：新丰—梅坑—永汉—增城、新江—翁源—良口—从化—广州、英德—银盏坳—花县—广州、良口—街口—广州、花县—广州。日军 267 → 281 事件、119 → 129 段路线；专题 515 → 529 事件、298 → 308 段。事件日期与地点仍待史料校订。 2026-11-20 起支持按地区浏览：新增 426 个历史行政区/地点、529 个事件与 308 段路线的地区归属，可按省/院辖市、县市、地点筛选；跨省路线不裁剪，放大后标注起终点。历史省界为 1931/1937/1938—1944/1945 四张示意面，手工绘制，非精确勘界；民国县界没有可自由再分发的公开数据，本期不绘制。
description.en:
From the Mukden Incident in September 1931 to Japan’s formal surrender in September 1945, China fought a fourteen-year war of resistance. This atlas follows the Japanese advance, China’s resistance forces, and the Allied forces, with separate layers for the KMT frontline forces, group armies, the Eighth Route Army, the New Fourth Army, South China guerrillas, the Chinese government, the Chinese people, and international organizations and multilateral conferences. It covers the frontline order of battle, the anti-Japanese base areas in North and Central China, and political and diplomatic events, from the fall of the Northeast and the outbreak of full-scale war to protracted resistance and final victory.

> Selected campaign routes (Shanghai, Pingxingguan, Xinkou, Taierzhuang, Lanfeng, Suizao, Kunlun Pass, Nanjing, Wuhan, Changsha (first, second, and third battles), Zaoyang–Yichang, Shanggao, South Shanxi, West Hubei, Changde, Hengyang, West Hunan, Western Yunnan, Hundred Regiments, the Expeditionary Force/Northern Burma, and Henan-Hunan-Guangxi) follow common historical maps; other routes remain simplified. From 16 November 2026 the C5–C7 endpoint review checks heads and tails in batches: the 21 Japanese advance endpoints now carry documented departure or capture nodes (Lingqiu, Datong, Qingdao, Heze, Kaifeng, Shangcheng, Wuhu, Guisui, Wuyang, Dangyang, Zhengzhou, Shenzhen, Mandalay, Hangzhou, Anyang, Jingzhou, Gong’an, Shaoyang), the January 28 leg becomes Hongkou–Zhabei, Lanfeng becomes Heze–Lanfeng–Kaifeng and Lu’an becomes Lu’an–Shangcheng; the 12 Chinese and 6 Allied/South China endpoints have also been checked: the Xinkou leg now follows the Nanhuaihua–Dabaishui battle line, the Hundred Regiments line is corrected to Yuci with a documented railway-sabotage event, Kunlun Pass gains the 5th Corps’ departure from Liuzhou, and the western Yunnan counter-offensive is anchored at the Salween crossing and Wanding; the three South China guerrilla area tails are registered as schematic activity zones. On 19 November 2026, 26 events and 12 route segments were added for 1932–1936 (the fall of Jinzhou, the defense of Shanhaiguan, the Rehe campaign, the Great Wall campaign, the Chahar People’s Anti-Japanese Allied Army, the Tanggu Truce, the He-Umezu and Qin-Doihara agreements, and the Suiyuan campaign), filling the gap between the establishment of Manchukuo and the December Ninth Movement. From 19 November 2026 the “Chinese resistance” narrative chain was split by participating units, and the mixed layer was further divided into “Chinese Government” and “Chinese People”: ten cross-theater connector segments (including Yangquan–Kunming) were removed, military routes were reassigned to the KMT frontline, group-army, Eighth Route Army, and Allied layers, and unit histories were added for the 74th, 5th, 10th, and 18th Armies and the 33rd Group Army. On 19 November 2026 a separate “International Organizations and Multilateral Conferences” layer was added: the Lytton Commission, the League Assembly’s adoption of its report, and the Nine-Power Conference were moved out of the Chinese government layer, and China’s 1931 appeal to the League was added. On 20 November 2026 the Eighth Route Army layer was expanded from 11 to 29 events, adding Yanmenguan, Yangmingbao, Qigencun, Shentouling, Xiangtangpu, Changlecun, Qihui, Huangtuling, Guanjianao, Langya Mountain, Hanluecun, the Southward Column, and the 1945 general counter-offensive, with routes increased from 9 to 24 segments. On 20 November 2026 three strategic turning points were added: the Luochuan Conference, which set “independent mountain guerrilla warfare”; the Shiguan Conference after the fall of Taiyuan, which dispersed the three divisions behind enemy lines; and the April 1938 directive on plains guerrilla warfare, followed by the 129th Division’s advance into southern Hebei. Events rose from 366 to 370 and routes from 238 to 241. On 20 November 2026 the entry of the 115th Division’s main force into Shandong (March 1939) was added, together with a note that the Shandong Column was formed from local uprising forces; events rose from 370 to 371 and routes from 241 to 242. From 20 November 2026 the Japanese layer was systematically expanded by actor: Changchun, Jilin, Qiqihar and the Japan–Manchukuo Protocol in the Northeast; Beiping, Tianjin, Zhangjiakou, Baoding, Shijiazhuang, Niangziguan, Guisui, Baotou, Jinan, Hangzhou, the Jinshanwei landing, the provisional and reformed puppet governments, the Kōain, Hirota’s Three Principles, the two Konoe statements, the North/Central China development companies and the Trautmann mediation in North China; Xiamen, Shantou, Chaozhou, Bao’an, Nanning, Hong Kong, the Shanghai Settlement, the Leizhou Peninsula and Guangzhouwan in South China; Nanchang, Anqing, Jiujiang, Xuzhou, Yichang, Ningbo–Shaoxing, the three falls of Wenzhou and the two falls of Fuzhou in Central China; the coastal blockade, the Chengdu bombing, the Ningbo/Changde/Zhejiang–Jiangxi bacteriological attacks and the Pingdingshan/Panjiayu/Beituan/Changjiao massacres at the strategic level; and the invasion of western Yunnan, Quzhou/Shangrao, the falls of Zhengzhou, Xuchang, Luoyang, Changsha, Hengyang, Guilin, Liuzhou and Dushan, the Hunan–Guangdong–Jiangxi border operation at Shaoguan/Nanxiong/Dayu/Ganzhou/Suichuan airfield, Laohekou and the retrocession of Taiwan in 1942–1945. Japanese events rose from 128 to 281 and routes from 64 to 124; the atlas rose from 377 to 529 events and from 243 to 303 routes. On 20 November 2026, M204 added Japanese actions in Hainan: the Tiandu iron mine, the Shilu–Basuo railway, the Yulin–Beili railway, the Tiandu mass grave, the first occupation, the 1942 “sweep” and the 1945 surrender, with the Tiandu–Yulin and Yulin–Beili supply routes; the atlas rose from 461 to 468 events and from 268 to 270 routes. On 20 November 2026, M205 further added the extent of the occupation: the falls of Yacheng, Ding’an, Wenchang, Chengmai, Jiaji, Lingao, Dan county, Lingshui, Tunchang, Gan’en, Changjiang, Wanning, Baoting and Ledong, together with an overview of the occupied county towns and garrisons by March 1940; Japan occupied the county towns and most market towns of 14 counties, established more than 360 posts and 195 maintenance associations, while Baisha county town and the Wuzhishan mountains were not permanently occupied. Japanese events rose from 220 to 235 and the atlas from 468 to 483 events, with routes unchanged. On 20 November 2026, M206 added Hainan landing points and departure points: Chengmai Bay/Laocheng, Yazhou Bay at Touzao/Dadan/Maling, Baimajing, Qinglan port and Basuo/Beili, with thirteen advance routes (Laocheng–Jinjiang, Baimajing–Xinying–Xinzhou, Touzao–Yacheng, Haikou–Ding’an, Haikou–Wenchang–Qinglan, Sanya–Tengqiao–Lingshui, Wenchang–Jiaji, Jinjiang–Lingao, Jiaji–Wanning, Lingshui–Baoting, Yacheng–Ledong, Basuo–Shilu and Basuo–Duntou–Xinjie); Japanese events rose from 235 to 240, routes from 91 to 104, and the atlas from 483 to 488 events and from 270 to 283 routes. The departure points for Tunchang, Gan’en and Jiaji remain uncertain and are not drawn as routes. On 20 November 2026, M207 refined the Guangdong front: the first occupation of Sanzao Island, the Liantang Bay landing and the Sanzao massacre; the three Dayawan landings at Pinghai/Renshan, Yanzaobei and Aotou/Xiachong; Danshui, Huizhou, Boluo, Zengcheng, Conghua and Humen; Sanshui, Foshan, Shunde, Panyu, Jiangmen, Xinhui, Zhongshan and the Tangjia/Xiangzhou landing; the first and third falls of Bao’an; Nan’ao and Chenghai; and the Guangzhou and Shantou surrenders, with fifteen routes. Japanese events rose from 240 to 267 and routes from 104 to 119; the atlas rose from 488 to 515 events and from 283 to 298 routes. On 20 November 2026, M208 added the northern Guangdong campaign nodes: Xiaolou/Zhengguo, Yonghan, Conghua, Liangkou, Meikeng/Lü tian, Xinfeng, Wengyuan, Yingde and Xinjiang in the first campaign; Hua county, Jiekou, Jilonggang, Liangkou and Shiliuhuading in the second; with five routes including Guangzhou–Hua county–Yinzhan’ao–Yuantan–Yingde. Japanese events rose from 267 to 281 and routes from 119 to 129; the atlas rose from 515 to 529 events and from 298 to 308 routes. Dates and coordinates still await historical review. From 20 November 2026 the atlas supports regional browsing: 426 historical administrative units/places and region assignments for all 529 events and 308 routes, filterable by province/municipality, county/city, or place. Cross-province routes stay whole and are labelled at both ends when zoomed in. The historical provincial outlines are four hand-drawn schematic snapshots (1931, 1937, 1938–1944, 1945), not survey-grade; county boundaries are not drawn because no redistributable Republican-era county geometry is available.

description.zh: 自 1931 年九一八事变起，日本关东军及后续侵华部队在中国东北、华北、华中、华南的进攻方向，路线为示意简化。
description.en: Advance directions of the Japanese Kwantung Army and subsequent invasion forces in Northeast, North, Central, and South China from 1931; routes are simplified.

description.zh: 国民政府及其战时政治、外交、经济与军事决策；军事行动路线已按部队拆分到国民党军、集团军、八路军、盟军等实体。
description.en: The Nationalist government and its wartime political, diplomatic, economic, and military decisions; military routes have been reassigned to the KMT, group-army, Eighth Route Army, and Allied layers.

description.zh: 国际联盟、九国公约会议等多边组织与会议的调查、调处与决议；行为主体是国际组织或会议，不是中国政府。
description.en: Investigations, mediation, and resolutions by the League of Nations, the Nine-Power Conference, and other multilateral bodies; the actor is the international organization or conference, not the Chinese government.

description.zh: 学生、知识分子、社会团体、民众武装、难民与战时救援；不包含政府决策与军队作战。
description.en: Students, intellectuals, civic groups, people’s armed forces, refugees, and wartime relief; government decisions and military operations are excluded.

name.en: Allied Forces and Chinese Expeditionary Force

description.zh: 太平洋战争爆发后，中国与美、英等盟国在中缅印战区协同作战；路线表现中国远征军入缅、撤退与缅北反攻。
description.en: After the Pacific War began, China fought alongside the United States, Britain, and other Allies in the China-Burma-India theater; routes show the Chinese Expeditionary Force’s entry into Burma, retreat, and the northern Burma counteroffensive.

description.zh: 国民革命军正面战场部队与作战序列；路线为示意简化，待史料校订。
description.en: National Revolutionary Army frontline units and order of battle; routes are simplified and await historical review.

description.zh: 国民革命军第八路军及其华北敌后根据地；路线为示意简化，待史料校订。
description.en: The Eighth Route Army and its base areas in North China; routes are simplified and await historical review.

description.zh: 国民革命军陆军新编第四军及其华中敌后根据地；路线为示意简化，待史料校订。
description.en: The New Fourth Army and its base areas in Central China; routes are simplified and await historical review.

description.zh: 东江纵队、琼崖纵队等华南抗日武装；路线为示意简化，待史料校订。
description.en: South China anti-Japanese forces including the Dongjiang and Qiongya columns; routes are simplified and await historical review.

description.zh: 国民革命军集团军层级部队与作战序列；路线为示意简化，待史料校订。
description.en: National Revolutionary Army group armies and their order of battle; routes are simplified and await historical review.

description.zh: 1931—1945 年中华民国名义省界示意，只描边不填充；边界为手工绘制，非精确勘界。
description.en: Schematic ROC provincial boundaries, 1931–1945. Outline only; hand-drawn, not survey-grade.
